dev.PushEvent: Push a commit to GitHub today
dev.IssueCommentEvent: Comment on an issue or pull request today

open-pack.title: Open your starter pack
open-pack.description: Tear it open in your inventory: a Rare or better is guaranteed.

collection.title: Meet your developers
collection.description: Look at your new cards in the collection.

team.title: Build a team of 3
team.description: Pick 3 cards in the Arena team builder.

battle.title: Fight your first battle
battle.description: Take your team into any league. Win or lose, it counts.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.text: The checklist in the corner pays {bits} BITS for your first steps.

dailyReward.title: Daily reward
dailyReward.text: Claim it in the Store every day: {first} to {last} BITS over a {days}-day streak{hasPack, select, yes {, plus {packName} on day {days}} other {}}.

missions.title: Missions
missions.text: {daily} new missions every day (swap one if you don't like it), {weekly} bigger ones every week, and a dev mission for real GitHub activity once you connect GitHub.

battles.title: Battles
battles.text: Battles pay BITS and XP (most leagues pay a little even on a loss). Beat a stronger team for up to +{pct}% BITS.

sprints.title: Sprints
sprints.text: A daily and a weekly theme: your {teamSize} strongest cards of it are scored automatically, and the top players win up to {bits} BITS.

levelUps.title: Level ups
levelUps.text: XP from packs and battles levels you up, and new levels give BITS and free boosters.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.text: {count} achievements with Bronze, Silver and Gold rewards.

github.title: Connect GitHub
github.text: +{bits} BITS and your own Signature card, which never drops from packs.

forge.title: Duplicates and the Forge
forge.text: Repeated cards turn into fragments; spend them in the Forge on the developer you want.

pity.title: Legendary pity
pity.text: A Legendary is guaranteed at least once every {packs} packs.

quirks.ancient-lurker: {years} years on GitHub, {repos, plural, one {# repo} other {# repos}}
